access: GM_ONLY. Keeper preparation, not a played turn and not a compulsory plot.
binding: Session 12 opens on the same ledge over the river, minutes after s11.text.077: Gaara and Chiyo alive and weakened, Kakashi exhausted after Kamui, Naruto, Sakura, Neji nearby; Suna shinobi preparing litters. Do not skip the scene forward without the player.

Shiki's hair has been silver-white since 1278 (s01.text.093); the dark-haired photo in s09.text.029 and s11.text.077 is a GM error. Any photo or memory of Shiki shows a white-haired youth; NPCs do not confirm the error.
Kakashi holds a Konoha field Bingo Book page that copies the Kiri entry (as played in s11.text.077); its contents stop at December 1284 and say nothing of the Sharingan, Susanoo or sage mode.
World autonomy first: Suna, Konoha, Kiri and Akatsuki act on their own clocks; canon events and their links arrive on time even without Shiki.
Shiki learns only what reaches his senses or a credible channel; Konoha's and Suna's decisions about him happen offscreen and reach him by people, letters or visible change.

events.trigger: Gaara and the Suna escort set out for Suna, or Shiki asks Gaara anything about his own standing.
events.question: What will Suna — its Kazekage and its council — decide Shiki is for them after the rescue: debtor, ally or threat?
endings: Gaara acknowledges a personal debt and gives Shiki a narrow, real guarantee (safe passage, a word, a contact) without hiding a nukenin.
The council overrules or binds Gaara: Suna keeps distance and quietly informs its ally Konoha or Kiri's hunters.
Suna wants something concrete in return — the Kiri dossier, medicine, the ruined seal — and the price becomes the bond.
Nothing is decided before the parties part; the question stays open with its tension.

events.trigger: Kakashi's and Neji's reports reach Tsunade (due 16–17.03), or Shiki travels with or near the Konoha team.
events.question: What will Konoha do with what Kakashi, Sakura and Neji saw of Shiki — and with Sasori's Tenchi intelligence on 25.03?
endings: Tsunade wants him used or watched: an offer, a channel or a quiet tail toward the Tenchi operation.
A harder faction (Root) opens its own file on his eyes and tissues — a hunt, not an offer.
Konoha keeps the Tenchi operation strictly to its own team; Shiki is left out and learns only by a trace.
The reports are shelved under war pressure; nothing changes for Shiki yet.

events.trigger: Shiki leaves the escort alone or lingers in the River Country after a fight seen by many; Kiri's standing order is capture alive with viable tissue.
events.question: Do Kiri's hunters, drawn by news of the Kazekage rescue, find a real trace of Shiki — and at what cost?
endings: A hunter team finds a real trace and tests him at a distance; Shiki sees their method and their warrant.
They lose the trail; only a broker or a rumor reaches Shiki.
They take the wrong target or a bystander pays for the confusion.
Nothing reaches the River Country in time.
